name: turn-monitor-drop-site
description: TurnMonitor (warren-1f85/warren-74a7, #1242): in-turn inspection lives in src/runs/stream/turn-monitor.ts, fed from the bridge loop at the per-delta drop site (before the noise-drop continue). A trip follows the enforceBudgetCap shape: persistKnownCost, emit event, cancelBurrowRun, break with terminalDetected {outcome:'cancelled'} and ctrl.abort() so a parked source iterator tears down; the catch branch treats monitorTripped abort as terminal, not errored. Stall detection needs a real setInterval owned by the monitor because a hung stream never iterates the bridge loop. TurnMonitor.ts cannot contain runtime-id literals (check:runtime-ids); the persist runtime tag is threaded from the bridge's toolRuntime.
